response.sql: WITH per_event AS (SELECT link_to_event, AVG(spent) AS avg_spent, AVG(remaining) AS avg_remaining FROM budget WHERE link_to_event IS NOT NULL GROUP BY link_to_event), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_remaining) AS mean_avg_remaining FROM per_event) SELECT p.link_to_event, p.avg_spent, p.avg_remaining, p.avg_remaining - o.mean_avg_remaining AS remaining_above_mean FROM per_event AS p CROSS JOIN overall AS o ORDER BY remaining_above_mean IS NULL, remaining_above_mean DESC LIMIT 10;
